template.name: ContextBar
template.event: if(manager:getContext() == "NURSERY_OCCUPIED") then if(game.eggReadyToHatch()) then manager:setButtonVisible("btn_hatch", false) end end if(manager:getContext() == "BREEDING_OCCUPIED") then if(game.isBreedingFinished()) then manager:setButtonVisible("btn_finish", false) manager:setButtonVisible("btn_mute", false) end end if(manager:getContext() == "DESTRUCTABLE_OBJECT") then if (game.timeLeftToDestoryObstacle() < 0) then manager:setButtonVisible("btn_remove", false) end end if(manager:getContext() == "BAKERY") then if (game.timeLeftToBake() < 0) then manager:setButtonVisible("btn_finish", false) end end if(manager:getContext() == "BUILDING_OBJECT") then if (game.timeLeftToBuild() < 0) then if game.canMuteStructure() == false then manager:setButtonVisible("btn_move", false) end manager:setButtonVisible("btn_speedup", false) end end
if game.getPopUp() ~= "island_select" then manager:setContext("MAP") game.pushPopUp("island_select") end
if game.isSelectedObjectPlaceable() == false then manager:setButtonEnabled("btn_confirm", false) end
local diamonds = game.diamondsRequiredToComplete(game.timeLeftToBuild()) if diamonds > 0 then game.showSpeedUpMessage("BUILD_OBJECT_SPEEDUP", "SPEED_UP_BUILD_OBJECT",game.timeLeftToBuild()) end

if game.isBelowRequiredLevelForObject()~=0 then local txt = game.getLocalizedText("NOTIFICATION_REQUIRES_LEVEL") txt = select(1, txt:gsub("XXX", game.isBelowRequiredLevelForObject())) game.displayNotification(txt) else game.clearObstacle(); manager:setContext("DESTRUCTABLE_OBJECT") end

local diamonds = game.diamondsRequiredToComplete(game.timeLeftToDestoryObstacle()) if diamonds > 0 then game.showSpeedUpMessage("DESTROY_OBSTACLE_SPEEDUP", "SPEED_UP_DESTROY_OBSTACLE",game.timeLeftToDestoryObstacle()) end

game.updateMonsterHud() if(game.monsterLevel(game.selectedMonsterId()) >= 15) then manager:setButtonVisible("btn_feed", false) end
if(game.monsterCount() == 1) then manager:setButtonEnabled("btn_sell", false) end

if game.getPopUp() ~= "object_info" then game.pushPopUp("object_info") if(game.selectedObjType() ~= 0) then manager:setButtonVisible("btn_feed", false) manager:setContextInfoVisible(false)
if(game.selectedObjType() == 6 or game.selectedObjType() == 2 or game.selectedObjType() == 3 or game.selectedObjType() == 1) then manager:setButtonVisible("btn_sell", false) end
else if(game.monsterCount() == 1) then manager:setButtonEnabled("btn_sell", false) end manager:setContextInfoVisible(true) if(game.monsterLevel(game.selectedMonsterId()) >= 15) then manager:setButtonVisible("btn_feed", false) end
manager:setProgressPercent("level", game.monsterTimesFed(game.selectedMonsterId())/4.0)
local happiness = (game.monsterHappiness(game.selectedMonsterId()).."%")
manager:setProgressLabel("happiness", happiness) manager:setProgressPercent("happiness", game.monsterHappiness(game.selectedMonsterId())/100.0) end end

game.updateStructureHud() if(game.structureUpgradeCost() == 0) then manager:setButtonVisible("btn_upgrade", false) end
if game.canMuteStructure() == false then print "No mute button" manager:setButtonVisible("btn_upgrade", false) manager:changeButton("btn_mute", "button_upgrade", "CONTEXTBAR_UPGRADE_LABEL", "upgrade_object", "template_upgradecost") end
game.updateStructureHud() if game.canMuteStructure() == false then print "No mute button" manager:setButtonVisible("btn_mute", false) end
game.popPopUp() if game.isBakeryUpgradable() then manager:setContext("BAKERY_IDLE") else manager:setContext("BAKERY_IDLE_NO_UPGRADE") end

local diamonds = game.diamondsRequiredToComplete(game.timeLeftToHatchEgg()) if diamonds > 0 then game.showSpeedUpMessage("HATCH_EGG_SPEEDUP", "SPEED_UP_HATCH_EGG",game.timeLeftToHatchEgg(),game.getEggGraphic(),"xml_resources/" .. game.getEggGraphic() .. ".xml") end

local diamonds = game.diamondsRequiredToComplete(game.timeLeftToBreed()) if diamonds > 0 then game.showSpeedUpMessage("FINISH_BREEDING_SPEEDUP", "SPEED_UP_BREEDING", game.timeLeftToBreed()) else game.finishBreeding() end

if(game.selectedObjType() == 3) then if game.canMuteStructure() then print "building_obj_oninit" manager:changeButton("btn_move", "button_mute", "CONTEXTBAR_MUTE_LABEL", "mute_object") game.updateStructureHud() else manager:setButtonVisible("btn_speedup", false) manager:changeButton("btn_move", "button_finish", "CONTEXTBAR_SPEED_LABEL", "speed_up_object") end end

local diamonds = game.diamondsRequiredToComplete(game.timeLeftToBake()) if diamonds > 0 then game.showSpeedUpMessage("FINISH_BAKING_SPEEDUP", "SPEED_UP_BAKING",game.timeLeftToBake()) else game.finishBaking() end
